evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat assertive statement of what the test does — asserted and defensible, but no ratification or operational settling language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule stated as a settled requirement — 'must not' / 'must produce' performs the settling as a load-bearing constraint the speaker expects others to meet.
